title: Create multi-platform GitHub Action build workflow for macOS, Linux, and Windows with popular formats

requirements.description: Create .github/workflows/release.yml supporting multiplatform builds across macOS (DMG), Linux (AppImage, DEB), and Windows (NSIS .exe, MSI)
Configure build matrix and prerequisites for all 3 OS platforms including Bun runtime, Rust toolchain, Linux WebKitGTK 4.1 and mold linker dependencies, and Tauri Action
Verify workflow YAML validity, matrix coverage, popular format artifacts, and passing test suites in scripts/agent/ci_workflow.test.ts
